english.note: Use this when you want to make the act of commending someone explicit rather than using the shorter 讚.
Use this as the all-purpose choice for openly praising or exalting someone or something, including when glorify means extol.

examples.english: The boss used the meeting to praise me for handling it well.
examples.traditional: 老闆喺會上稱讚我處理得好。
examples.jyutping: lou5 baan2 hai2 wui6 soeng6 cing1 zaan3 ngo5 cyu5 lei5 dak1 hou2

examples.english: The teacher used the speech to glorify our efforts.
examples.traditional: 老師喺台上稱讚我哋嘅努力。
examples.jyutping: lou5 si1 hai2 toi1 soeng6 cing1 zaan3 ngo5 dei6 ge3 nou5 lik6
